title: WaterColor "Beachside #6" 1848 E. Co. Hwy 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 10 amenity access bands.**- Gulf-front - Access to separate private condo pool- Dune walkover is near your front door- Steps away from the WaterColor Beach Club- Amazing balcony views of the emerald waters- High-speed wireless internet- 3 adult bikes provided (4 Max Per HOA) - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: This wonderful gulf-front townhome offers great views of the Gulf of Mexico and the community swimming pool. The living room, dining room, and kitchen are all located on the second floor. The large living room offers plenty of seating; a television, DVD/CD player, and French doors that open onto a furnished balcony showing great views of the Gulf and swimming pool. The dining area is just off the kitchen and seats 6 comfortably. The large open kitchen features stainless steel appliances and granite countertops, and a breakfast bar that seats 4. Located on the second floor are 2 spacious bedrooms. The primary suite has a king-size bed, TV, DVD, and a furnished balcony offering great views. The bathroom features a shower and jetted tub, double vanity, and walk-in closet. The second bedroom also has a king-size bed, TV, and a connected bathroom with a single vanity and shower. A third bedroom, located on the first floor, is furnished with 2 queen-size beds, TV, and single vanity and shower. An added bonus is a den on the first floor equipped with bunk beds, TV, DVD player, and a furnished porch that looks out over the pool. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Living Area: Twin-over-Twin Built-in Bunks, Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only Please note that starting March 15, 2014, all Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be arranged through The Electric Cart Company. Only one cart is allowed per home, and rentals are on a first-come, first-served basis, with a limit of 60 vehicles allowed in the community at any time. Additionally, WaterColor condominium buildings do not have exterior outlets for charging Low-Speed Vehicles/Low-Speed Vehicles (LSVs). 360 Blue does not provide extension cords for charging per HOA. Please discuss charging needs directly with your rental company.Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
